newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count down 6 to 845 in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count down 6 to 845 in latest week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 845 as of January 3, down six from the prior week and 134 above the year-ago total of 711, Baker Hughes Inc reported.
The number of rigs drilling on land fell by seven to 704, while rigs working offshore rose one to 117. The number of rigs active in inland waters was steady at 24.
Among the individual states, the biggest changes occurred in Louisiana, which was down nine, Oklahoma down 11 and in Texas, which was up 21.
Gulf Mexico drilling rigs stood at 111.
A total of 363 rigs were exploring for crude oil, up 10 from last week. The number of rigs searching for gas was down 16 at 480, while the number of miscellaneous drilling projects remained at two.
There were 184 rigs drilling directionally, 64 drilling horizontally and 597 drilling vertically.
In Canada, the number of working rigs surged by 154 in the week to 358 versus 300 a year ago.
The weekly rig count reflects the number of rigs exploring for oil and gas, not those producing oil and gas.
